create_nat_loss_criterion: create a LabelSmoothedDualImitationCriterion instance with a task and label smoothing value for non-autoregressive translation loss
compute_loss_with_label_smoothing: compute NLL loss with optional label smoothing on model outputs and targets using _compute_loss method
forward_loss_computation: run the forward pass to compute loss for a sample by calling the forward method with a model and sample dict
reduce_metrics_aggregation: aggregate logging outputs from data parallel training workers using the reduce_metrics static method
add_criterion_args: add the label smoothing argument to the Fairseq argument parser using the add_args static method
